item.description:
Codex Whip 1.8.0
Same model. Keep going.
Automatically retry capacity errors and resume unfinished work when ordinary quota becomes available again.
• Five-minute checks and three-minute capacity retries by default. • Retry and check intervals, message editing and activity history from the menu bar. • A continuous demo with original whip sounds. • A clean blue app icon and more time for a cold first launch.
Uses your existing Codex CLI session, model and settings. Never changes accounts or consumes reset credits.
macOS 14 or later. Apple silicon and Intel downloads. This community build is ad hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.
